examples.title: enableHapticFeedback18+
examples.description:
enableHapticFeedback(enabled: boolean)
Specifies whether to enable haptic feedback.
To enable haptic feedback, you must declare the ohos.permission.VIBRATE permission under requestPermissions in the module.json5 file of the project.

examples.title: Example 1: Using Basic Slider Styles
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to control the display of the tooltip, current step, and slider thumb and track by configuring style, showTips, and showSteps.

examples.title: Example 2: Using Custom Slider Styles
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the slider styles by setting blockBorderColor, blockSize, blockBorderWidth, and blockStyle for the slider block, stepSize and stepColor for the step, trackBorderRadius for the track's corner radius, and selectedBorderRadius for the selected part's corner radius.
examples.code:
@Entry
@Component
struct SliderExample {
  @State tipsValue: number = 40;
  build() {
    Column({ space: 8 }) {
      Text('block').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.OutSet, value: 40 })
        .blockSize({ width: 40, height: 40 })
        .blockBorderColor(Color.Red)
        .blockBorderWidth(5)
      Divider()
      Text('step').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.InSet, value: 40, step: 10 })
        .showSteps(true)
        .stepSize(8)
        .stepColor(Color.Yellow)
      Divider()
      Text('track').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.InSet, value: 40 })
        .trackBorderRadius(2)
      Divider()
      Text('selected').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.InSet, value: 40 })
        .selectedBorderRadius(2)
      Divider()
      Text('blockStyle').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.OutSet, value: 40 })
        .blockStyle({ type: SliderBlockType.DEFAULT })
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.OutSet, value: 40 })
        .blockStyle({ type: SliderBlockType.IMAGE, image: $r('sys.media.ohos_app_icon') })
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.OutSet, value: 40 })
        .blockSize({ width: '60px', height: '60px' })
        .blockColor(Color.Red)
        .blockStyle({ type: SliderBlockType.SHAPE, shape: new Path({ commands: 'M60 60 M30 30 L15 56 L45 56 Z' }) })
      Divider()
      Text('tips').fontSize(9).fontColor(0xCCCCCC).margin(15).width('90%')
      Slider({ style: SliderStyle.InSet, value: this.tipsValue })
        .showTips(true, this.tipsValue.toFixed())
        .onChange(value => {
          this.tipsValue = value;
        })
    }
  }
}

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing a Custom Slider
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to customize the Slider component using a style builder to define the content area. Clicking the increase button will increment the progress bar by the step size set in the original Slider component, and clicking the decrease button will decrement the progress bar, triggering the onChange event of the original component.

examples.title: Example 4: Applying a Color Gradient Effect and Implementing Support for Digital Crown Interactions
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to a color gradient effect to the slider using colorGradient and implement support for digital crown interactions through focusable, defaultFocus, and focusOnTouch.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Slider Prefix and Suffix
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the prefix and suffix of the slider using prefix and suffix, defining their custom content and accessibility configuration. After the accessibility configuration is specified, the screen reader announces the accessibility text accordingly.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Accessibility Text for Slider Step Markers
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set accessibility text for step markers in a Slider component using showSteps. The screen reader announces the set accessibility text accordingly. The showSteps attribute is added since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting Two-Way Binding for the Slider
examples.description: This example shows how to implement data synchronization by binding the value property of SliderOptions to a variable using the $$ two-way binding operator, available since API version 11.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting a Gradient Color for the Slider Thumb
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set a gradient color for the Slider component's thumb using the blockColor attribute.

examples.title: Example 9: Setting the Background Color of a Slider
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the gradient color stop of the specified color gamut, including the offset and color, using trackColorMetrics. In this example, colorSpace is of the ColorSpace.DISPLAY_P3 type. You need to call the setWindowColorSpace API of the corresponding window to set the current window to the wide color gamut mode. For details, see setWindowColorSpace.
The trackColorMetrics API is supported since API version 23.
